task_type.instructions: Classify the main user intent using the supplied task context.

criteria.investigation: Diagnose, explain, or establish evidence about a behavior
criteria.follow_up: Continue or adjust a task already in progress
criteria.other: Question, discussion, or request outside code execution

readiness.instructions: Can a coding agent make meaningful progress now? A short request is not automatically ambiguous. Do not demand a root cause, exact code locations, or other details the agent can discover. Use clarify only when a consequential objective, target, or constraint is missing.

criteria.accept: Task has a usable objective and starting point; discovery is allowed
criteria.clarify: A specific missing objective, target, or constraint prevents meaningful progress
criteria.pass_through: Normal follow-up, discussion, or question that should not be blocked

missing_target.instructions: Is the request missing the observable symptom, affected behavior, or question needed to identify what to investigate?

criteria.true: The intended target or observable behavior cannot be identified from the supplied context
criteria.false: The supplied context provides a usable target, or this is not an investigation
